name: notion_blocks_append
description: Append new child blocks to the block (or page) specified; children are added to the bottom in order (PATCH /v1/blocks/{block_id}/children)

block_id.description: Identifier for a block. Also accepts a page ID; children are appended to that page.

children.description: Child content to append: an array of block objects, e.g. [{"type": "paragraph", "paragraph": {"rich_text": [{"text": {"content": "..."}}]}}]. A simplified form [{"type": "to_do", "text": "...", "checked": false}] is also accepted. Supported types: paragraph, heading_1, heading_2, heading_3, bulleted_list_item, numbered_list_item, to_do, quote, callout.
